privileged_info_for_vlm: In 3OG7, the gatekeeper residue is Thr529. In 1UWH (DFG-out), the DFG-Phe (Phe595 in 3OG7 numbering) moves significantly (approx 10-15A) compared to 3OG7 (DFG-in). The T529M mutation in BRAF is a known resistance mechanism because the larger Methionine sidechain sterically hinders the binding of vemurafenib in the ATP-binding site. Expected BSA for vemurafenib is typically in the range of 300-500 A^2.
